headline: A new phase inside The Prestige City, Sarjapur Road.
pitch: Garden Breeze is part of The Prestige City, one of the largest townships on Sarjapur Road. Buyers get a new home inside a township that is already taking shape.

reasons.title: A metro line is planned for this road
reasons.text: The Red Line (Hebbal to Sarjapura, 37 km, 28 stations) was approved by the Karnataka Cabinet in December 2024. The revised project report targets 2033.
reasons.source: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026

reasons.title: Close to the tech corridor
reasons.text: Sarjapur Road feeds the Outer Ring Road offices. The Blue Line's Silk Board to KR Pura stretch (19.75 km) runs through Bellandur and Marathahalli.

reasons.title: A new ring road is planned
reasons.text: The Bengaluru Business Corridor (Peripheral Ring Road) is a 73 km road with a reported 2029 deadline, linking the Devanahalli side with the Sarjapur side.

reasons.title: New launches are holding their price
reasons.text: Asking prices for new launches on Sarjapur Road rose 3.1% while the wider average stayed flat at about ₹12,250 per sq.ft.

upcoming.status: Proposed 37 km line with 28 stations. Karnataka Cabinet approved it in December 2024; central approval was awaited. The revised project report targets April 2033.
upcoming.why: It would give Sarjapur Road its own metro line through Koramangala to Hebbal. Treat the date as a target, not a promise.
upcoming.source: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026

upcoming.what: Blue Line metro, Silk Board to KR Pura
upcoming.status: 19.75 km along the Outer Ring Road through Bellandur and Marathahalli. Trial runs were expected from late 2026.
upcoming.why: Puts the main office belt that Sarjapur Road residents work in onto the metro.

upcoming.status: 73 km ring road with a reported 2029 deadline.
upcoming.why: Takes through-traffic off the Outer Ring Road and shortens cross-city trips.

timeline.what: Red Line approved by State Cabinet

timelineSource: Wikipedia (Namma Metro line pages), read 26 Nov 2026; Square Yards, 2026; Sattva Group market note, 2026. Government target dates can move.
band: Sarjapur Road has no metro today. The buyers choosing it now are buying the offices nearby first and the metro plan second.

area.name: Sarjapur Road
area.source: Square Yards property rates page, read 26 Nov 2026. Asking prices from listings, not registered sale prices.
